data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to asynchronously read and write Zip files.
data.what_it_does: Allows fast reading and writing of Zip archives both synchronously and asynchronously with low memory consumption. It also provides functions to extract a Zip archive into a folder with optional progress callbacks. The underlying C library is integrated using Dart FFI.
use_when: You need to handle large Zip files on low or medium range devices without high memory consumption.
You require asynchronous Zip reading and writing capabilities in your Flutter application.
avoid_when: You do not want to rely on a native C library integration via FFI.
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS (as only android and ios platforms are listed).
strengths: Low memory consumption compared to standard libraries that load entire files into memory.
Supports both synchronous and asynchronous operations.
Includes built-in extraction functions with progress tracking capabilities.
weaknesses: Limited platform support explicitly documented (android, ios).
Requires manual resource management (must call `close()` to avoid leaks or unfinished zip files).

alternatives.name: archive
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick archive if you want a pure Dart solution without FFI bindings or if you need support for a wider variety of archive formats beyond just Zip.
